creates_law_reviewed.class: VERIFICATION -- it confirms five relayed values and makes explicit a corollary of Jorgensen's inequality; the inequality is classical and the invariance is Fricke-Vogt.
creates_law_reviewed.basis: The one non-derivative step is the observation that the parabolic meridian collapses the Jorgensen sum onto |kappa-2|, which explains why B309's unit obstruction IS J(m004). That is an identification between two banked facts, not a new general proposition, and it carries an unproved step (that the meridian pair generates) which is named rather than assumed. If the J = |kappa-2| identification is wanted as a law for the four manifolds beyond m004, the generating-pair step must be closed first, on its own arc.

claim_one_line: |kappa-2| AS A LOWER BOUND ON J: ALL FIVE RELAYED VALUES CONFIRMED EXACTLY, THE TWO CLAIMS ARE ONE CLAIM, AND THE BOUND IS ATTAINED ON A PARABOLIC MERIDIAN IN EVERY ONE. Relay: '|kappa-2| is a genuine invariant and a lower bound on J -- m004 = 1 (attained, per Callahan), m009 = sqrt2, m003 = 4, v2873 = 3 sqrt3, m202 = 7', with the 3-generator values withdrawn entirely. RECOMPUTED HERE on the geometric holonomy, default 2-generator presentation, kappa = tr[a,b]: 1.000000000, 1.414213562, 4.000000000, 5.196152423, 7.000000000 -- ALL FIVE EXACT (m202 is TWO-cusped, the other four one-cusped). THE TWO CLAIMS ARE ONE: J(G) = inf over GENERATING PAIRS of (|tr^2 A - 4| + |tr[A,B] - 2|), so IF kappa is pair-independent then J = |kappa-2| + inf|tr^2 A - 4| >= |kappa-2| because the first term is non-negative -- THE LOWER BOUND IS A COROLLARY OF THE INVARIANCE, not a second fact -- and equality requires |tr^2 A - 4| = 0, i.e. tr A = +-2, i.e. A PARABOLIC, which is the whole content of 'attained'. INVARIANCE HOLDS AND MY FIRST READING OF IT WAS WRONG: a first pass reported |kappa-2| VARYING across pairs (m004 1 vs 3, m009 sqrt2 vs 4, v2873 3sqrt3 vs 9), which would have refuted the claim; WITHDRAWN, because the offending pair (a^2 b, b) is NOT an elementary Nielsen move -- <a^2b, b> contains a^2 and b, not necessarily a, so it need not generate the same group -- and kappa is conserved by the Markov/Vieta moves (Fricke-Vogt), the conservation this bench used in B1347's classifier, so a DIFFERING kappa is evidence of a different Nielsen class rather than evidence against invariance. Redone with genuine Nielsen moves only, 12 equivalent pairs each: spreads 6.0e-15, 4.0e-15, 2.7e-15, 5.1e-13, 4.4e-15 -- CONSTANT to machine precision in every case. SCOPE STATED BECAUSE IT IS EXACTLY E72'S HAZARD: Nielsen-invariance is not invariance over ALL generating pairs, since a group can carry Nielsen-INEQUIVALENT pairs and a smaller |kappa-2| in one of them would break the bound; E72's own instance is two kappas on two different groups (B309's meridian pair vs B448's fibre pair). The right statement is INVARIANT OF THE NIELSEN CLASS, and the bound is rigorous modulo no inequivalent class having a smaller kappa; weak supporting evidence is that the three non-Nielsen pairs sampled all gave LARGER values (3, 4, 9 against 1, sqrt2, 3sqrt3). THE BOUND IS ATTAINED IN ALL FIVE, NOT ONLY AT m004: every one has |tr(meridian)| = 2.000000, PARABOLIC, and a meridian-containing pair reproduces the default kappa exactly, so on that pair the Jorgensen sum is 0 + |kappa-2| = |kappa-2|, giving J <= |kappa-2| and with the corollary above J = |kappa-2| EXACTLY, ATTAINED -- PROVIDED THE MERIDIAN PAIR GENERATES, which is the one unproved step, known for m004 (Callahan) and for the other four only CONSISTENT with Nielsen-equivalence since equal kappa is necessary and not sufficient. THIS IS STRONGER THAN THE RELAY CLAIMED: they said lower bound; the computation says the bound is REACHED, so modulo the generating step these are the JORGENSEN NUMBERS THEMSELVES -- J(m009) = sqrt2, J(m003) = 4, J(v2873) = 3 sqrt3, J(m202) = 7. A DETAIL EASY TO MISS: the DEFAULT presentation pair does NOT attain J for m004, its sum being 3.605551 + 1 = 4.605551 against J = 1, so the infimum is genuinely over pairs and anyone re-deriving J from the default presentation gets the wrong number. WHERE IT MEETS THE RECORD: |kappa-2| = 1 on m004's MERIDIAN pair is B309's banked unit obstruction (kappa-2 = omega^2), which B1345 already identified as J(m004) = 1 from the other side; this arc adds WHY they coincide -- the meridian is parabolic, so the |tr^2-4| term drops and the Jorgensen sum collapses onto |kappa-2|. THE UNIT OBSTRUCTION IS THE JORGENSEN NUMBER BECAUSE THE MERIDIAN IS PARABOLIC, a sentence that was implicit and is now explicit. THE 3-GENERATOR WITHDRAWAL costs nothing here: all five manifolds carry 2-generator presentations (verified), so no 3-generator quantity enters any number in this arc. FENCES: nothing reaches CLAIMS.md, F2 or Gate 5; no value compared to any measurement, these being manifold invariants and not couplings; and the J identifications are stated WITH their unproved step named. ADDENDUM 1 -- THE GENERATING STEP CLOSED FOR FOUR OF FIVE, AND SECTION 4'S 'ALL FIVE' CORRECTED. The meridian words settle three immediately: m004 and m009 have meridian 'ab' and v2873 has 'BA' = (ab)^-1, and a^-1.(ab) = b, so <mer,a> = <mer,b> = <a,b> PROVED. THE CORRECTION: a NECESSARY condition is that the images of P and x generate H_1, and computed from exponent vectors against the abelianised relators, m202's (mer,a) has index 3 and (mer,b) index 2 -- BOTH FORBIDDEN -- so the pair section 4 exhibited for m202 is NOT a generating pair, contributes nothing to the infimum, and yields NO upper bound; section 4's 'attained in all five' is WITHDRAWN AS STATED. ATTAINMENT IS THEN RECOVERED FROM OTHER PARABOLICS, the meridian not being the only one (the whole peripheral subgroup is parabolic, and m202 has TWO cusps): m202's longitude(0) = 'bba' pairs with b, passes the H_1 test, gives |kappa-2| = 7.000000, and GENERATES PROVABLY since b^-2.(b^2 a) = a; likewise meridian(1) = 'bbAb' with b. SO m202 IS PROVED AFTER ALL, via the longitude rather than the first meridian. m003 REMAINS THE ONE OPEN CASE: (mer,a), (lon,a) and (lon,b) all pass the necessary condition and reproduce kappa = 4, but 'ABABB' and 'ABAbab' each contain a more than once so no generator is immediately recoverable and generation is NOT PROVED. THE CORRECTED STATEMENT KEEPS THE TWO DIRECTIONS APART, which section 4 bundled: UPPER, J <= |kappa-2|, is now ESTABLISHED for four of five (m004, m009, v2873, m202) by exhibiting a parabolic GENERATING pair whose Jorgensen sum is 0 + |kappa-2|, and conditional for m003 only; LOWER, J >= |kappa-2|, is STILL CONDITIONAL for four of five, needing kappa constant over ALL generating pairs and not merely the Nielsen class. THE EXCEPTION IS THE INTERESTING ONE: m004 needs NEITHER proviso, because Jorgensen's inequality gives J >= 1 UNCONDITIONALLY and |kappa-2| = 1, so J(m004) = 1 IS FULLY ESTABLISHED WITH NO OPEN PREMISE -- the only one of the five that is -- precisely because m004 sits at the FLOOR of the inequality, which is what makes B309's |kappa-2| = 1 a UNIT obstruction rather than merely a small one, and why m004 is the case Callahan could settle. For the other four the honest form is J <= |kappa-2| (proved, except m003) with equality iff no Nielsen-inequivalent generating pair carries a smaller kappa. WHAT I GOT WRONG: section 4's proviso was stated once but needed stating PER MANIFOLD, and for m202 it is FALSE for the pair used; the abelianisation test that caught it is three lines long and should have been in section 4.
